creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-10-01: "gradual context usage coloring".

Today the ring beside an agent row is secondary-label grey until 80% (`SidebarModel.contextWarning`), then orange. Ask: a color that moves with the fill - e.g. calm at low use, warming through amber to red near compaction - so a glance says how close, not just past-or-not. Keep it clear of the agent-state colors and readable in light and dark; consider making the ends configurable under `[colors]` like the other colors Muster invented.
title: 🌡️ The context ring changes color gradually as it fills
